title: 第1章 神秘黑袍人第2章 竟是源境
content_zh:
（第二部第一章内容，与第一步番外篇第13章衔接，还没看完番外篇的书友，记得先回第一步看番外篇。
）祖地，祖心界外，一片荒凉山脉高空。
一名黑斗袍男人，悬浮在空中，目光遥望着远方祖心界，眼中闪过一丝贪婪和兴奋之色。
这地方真是一块宝地啊，这回要发了，哈哈！
神秘人的声音低沉而沙哑，充满了兴奋和期待。
就在此时，一道身影悄然出现在他面前。
来人，正是林云！
林云一脸警惕地看着眼前神秘人。
幸好此人现在所处的地方，是祖心界外面，还没有进入祖心界内，要不然，自己就探查不到他的位置了。
这也是林云心中，长久以来的一个疑惑，祖心界究竟有何特殊？
曾经的天道，完全无法探查祖心界。
自己继承天道后，它曾经的一些束缚，在林云这儿是不存在的，比如自己离开初始之地，依旧能保持源境实力。
可探查祖心界这一点，林云依旧做不到。
林云现身后，与这黑斗袍男人目光对视一眼。
这黑斗袍男人身上的气息，很奇怪！
于是林云立刻尝试着，对他进行探查，以及想要侵入他大脑，搜查信息和记忆。
可林云发现，自己竟然做不到！
不但无法搜寻他的记忆和信息，甚至连他是什么修炼境界，林云都无法探查到？
这瞬间在林云心中，激起惊涛骇浪！
自己踏入源境，成为天道之后，还是第一次遇到这样的怪事！

“小子，你想探查我？”
黑斗袍男人，目光幽幽的盯着林云。
“你是什么人？”
林云目光上下打量着此人，眼神中的警惕更加浓烈。
他竟然能发现，自己试图在探查他？
这家伙究，竟是什么来头！
“你又是什么人？”
黑斗袍男子，不以为然。
“我叫林云。”
林云直接报出自己的名号。
“我可懒得管你叫什么，赶紧给我滚远点，惹恼了爷爷，小心你没命！”
黑袍男人满脸不耐烦，语气更是嚣张。
听到这样的回答，林云内心更加诧异了。
自己成为天道后，‘林云’二字，在整个祖地，绝对是无人不知，无人不晓的。
虽然林云不知道他的真实身份，但林云以为自己报出名号后，对方自然会害怕，对方自然会跪伏行礼，拜见自己这个天道。
可看这黑袍男人的反应，他听到自己的名字时，没有丝毫波澜，似乎他根本就没听说过自己？
加上此人身上的气息也很奇怪，林云从未感受到过。
如果他不来自于祖地，那么更不可能来自于，祖地下的星界和小世界了！
因为那些世界的修士实力，跟祖地有着极大差距，不可能达到连自己都无法探查的地步。
难道说……
content_en:
(The content of the first chapter of the second part is connected with the 13th chapter of the extra chapter of the first step. For book friends who have not read the extra chapter, remember to go back to the first step to read the extra chapter.
) Ancestral land, outside the boundary of the ancestral heart, is a desolate mountain high in the sky.
A man in a black robe was suspended in the air, looking into the distant ancestral heart world, with a trace of greed and excitement flashing in his eyes.
This place is really a treasure, it’s going to be published this time, haha!
The mysterious man's voice was low and hoarse, full of excitement and anticipation.
At this moment, a figure quietly appeared in front of him.
The person coming is none other than Lin Yun!
Lin Yun looked at the mysterious man in front of him with vigilance.
Fortunately, the place where this person is now is outside the Ancestral Heart Realm and has not yet entered the Ancestral Heart Realm. Otherwise, I would not be able to detect his location.
This has also been a long-standing doubt in Lin Yun's mind. What is so special about the Ancestral Heart Realm?
The former way of heaven was completely unable to explore the ancestral heart realm.
After he inherited the way of heaven, some of the constraints it once had did not exist with Lin Yun. For example, he could still maintain the strength of the source realm after leaving the original place.
But Lin Yun still couldn't explore the ancestral heart realm.
After Lin Yun appeared, he looked at the man in black robe.
The aura of this man in black robe is very strange!
So Lin Yun immediately tried to explore him and invade his brain to search for information and memories.
But Lin Yun found that he couldn't do it!
Not only was it impossible to search for his memories and information, Lin Yun couldn't even find out what level of cultivation he was at?
This moment stirred up a storm in Lin Yun's heart!
After I stepped into the Source Realm and became the Heavenly Dao, this was the first time I encountered such a strange thing!
"Boy, you want to check on me?"
The man in black robe stared at Lin Yun with a faint look.
"Who are you?"
Lin Yun looked this person up and down, the vigilance in his eyes became even stronger.
He could actually find out that he was trying to probe him?
What is the origin of this guy?
"Who are you?"
The man in black robe disagreed.
"My name is Lin Yun."
Lin Yun directly reported his name.
"I'm too lazy to care what your name is. Get out of here quickly. If you annoy grandpa, you may die!"
The man in black robe was impatient, and his tone was even more arrogant.
Hearing such an answer, Lin Yun was even more surprised.
After he became the Heavenly Dao, the word "Lin Yun" was definitely known to everyone in the entire ancestral land.
Although Lin Yun didn't know his true identity, Lin Yun thought that after he reported his name, the other person would naturally be afraid, and the other person would naturally kneel down and salute, and pay homage to him as a god.
But judging from the reaction of the man in black robe, when he heard his name, he didn't feel any emotion at all. It seemed that he had never heard of him at all?
In addition, the aura on this person was also very strange, Lin Yun had never felt it before.
If he does not come from the ancestral land, then it is even less likely that he comes from the star realm and small world under the ancestral land!
Because the strength of the monks in those worlds is very different from that of the ancestral land, it is impossible for them to reach the point where they cannot even detect it.
Could it be that...
